channel.title: Detroit Sports Nation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Detroit Sports Nation (detroitsportsnation.com)

item.title: Report: Detroit Tigers Make One Thing Clear After Signing Framber Valdez
item.description: Despite signing Framber Valdez and facing a record-setting arbitration case with Tarik Skubal, the Detroit Tigers are not considering a trade. Here’s why Detroit remains all-in.

item.title: David Montgomery Sends Clear Message About His Role in Detroit
item.description: Detroit Lions RB David Montgomery responds to his reduced role in 2025, explains the Jahmyr Gibbs dynamic, and shares optimism under Dan Campbell and new OC Drew Petzing.

item.title: Blockbuster Trade Offer Sends Maxx Crosby to Detroit Lions
item.description: The Detroit Lions could land Maxx Crosby in a blockbuster trade. Here’s a realistic trade package, why Detroit would do it, and how Crosby changes the Lions’ defense.

item.title: Aidan Hutchinson Explains Why 2026 Will Be Different
item.description: Detroit Lions DE Aidan Hutchinson reflects on a missed sack record, his dominant 2025 season, and why he believes the Lions will rebound in 2026.

item.title: Before Detroit Lions Fans Get Too Excited, Here’s the Truth About the Maxx Crosby Rumor
item.description: An NFL insider confirms Maxx Crosby wants out of Las Vegas, but rumors linking him to the Detroit Lions need to be treated with caution. Here’s what’s real—and what isn’t.

item.title: Aidan Hutchinson Addresses Maxx Crosby Trade Rumors Head-On
item.description: Detroit Lions star Aidan Hutchinson reacts to Maxx Crosby trade rumors, calls the pairing “dangerous,” and explains why it likely won’t happen — for now.

item.title: BREAKING: Detroit Tigers/Tarik Skubal Receive in Arbitration Case
item.description: The Detroit Tigers have received a ruling in Tarik Skubal’s arbitration case, a decision that carries major implications for the franchise following a blockbuster pitching signing.

item.title: Detroit Lions Decide on Next Tight Ends Coach
item.description: The Detroit Lions have promoted Steve Oliver from within, naming him the team’s new tight ends coach after Tyler Roehl’s departure to Iowa State.

item.title: Matthew Stafford Announces Decision for 2026
item.description: Matthew Stafford officially announces he will return for the 2026 NFL season after winning MVP, ending all retirement speculation.

item.title: Detroit Lions Star Snubbed at NFL Honors
item.description: The Detroit Lions were shut out at the 2025 NFL Honors, highlighted by a controversial snub of right tackle Penei Sewell for Protector of the Year despite elite PFF grades.
